target.one_means: Listed in the saved VulnCheck KEV snapshot
target.zero_means: Not listed in that snapshot; not evidence of never being exploited
target.missing_or_nonboolean: Ineligible; never silently converted to zero
target.interpretation: Retrospective snapshot classification, not CISA KEV prediction or future inclusion

candidate_text_policy: Quarantine complete documents containing explicit catalogue cues or numeric EPSS disclosures. Other exploitation or other-CVE mentions are review flags, not automatic rejection. Human review is still pending.
evaluation_status: No fresh independent final test identified. Existing roles are audited, never reassigned; the previous primary test is already observed.
protocol_status: Frozen audit specification; proposed training protocol pending readiness review

proposed_training.backbone: Existing two-layer EdgeTypeGNNLayer, fixed no_coref extraction; no new backbone search
proposed_training.loss: Binary cross-entropy with logits; any positive-class weighting fitted on training only and fixed across matched variants
proposed_training.selection_metric: Validation average precision (AP), not a test-selected threshold or best test seed
proposed_training.threshold: Report fixed 0.5 and a validation-F1-selected threshold with largest-threshold tie rule; freeze before any designated final evaluation
proposed_training.uncertainty: CVE-level paired comparisons with dependency limitations; no multiple-comparison-adjusted superiority claim
proposed_training.future_epss_addition: Separate preregistered matched extension; score date must be justified. No EPSS predictor in the initial study.
